summary.intent: Extend the CipherBox Phase 70.1 planning research doc (.planning/phases/70.1-rotation-read-plane-durability-and-deep-crash-resume-soundne/70.1-RESEARCH.md) with grounded findings on desktop FUSE rotation live-wiring (SC#8 / D-14..D-17), then verify and commit the extension.
summary.outcome: Background research agent extended the RESEARCH.md to 789 lines (added Sharp Question 7 with 5 subsections, 8 new SC#8 test-map rows, 3 new pitfalls, updated architecture/STRIDE sections) at HIGH confidence with every line reference re-checked against the live tree; the assistant then ran verify+commit on the file.

repo: CipherBox planning docs live under .planning/phases/<phase>/<phase>-RESEARCH.md and follow a structured format: Sharp Questions, Pitfalls, and an SC# (Scenario/Coverage) test map.

The production RotationDeps adapter for FUSE rotation does not exist yet — only a test FakeDeps implementation exists; building the real adapter is an assembly job except for the key-checkpoint seam, which is genuinely new.

publish_ipns's PublishResult::Conflict only returns current_sequence_number, not the full PublishedNode the rotation engine's PublishAttempt::Conflict expects — any adapter must do an extra resolve+fetch round-trip to materialize `remote`, or concurrent-add merge silently breaks.

SentSharesCache defaults to Default/empty(), which currently makes an unrefreshed cache treat every shared delete as private — a fail-open revocation bypass; the fix must key off 'successfully refreshed once' rather than 'set is non-empty'.

ancestor_ipns_chain and the rotation gate currently return Vec/panic on failure with no way to express 'fail closed' — both need signature changes (Result or an authoritativeness bit) before the fail-closed fixes are even expressible.

code.finding: Intended location for the production RotationDeps adapter; currently unimplemented, only FakeDeps exists in tests.
resolve_ipns_verified — primitive backing RotationDeps' resolve method.
fetch_content — primitive backing RotationDeps' fetch method (paired with decode_published_node).

publish_ipns — backs RotationDeps publish; its Conflict variant only returns current_sequence_number, missing the full PublishedNode needed by PublishAttempt::Conflict (409 conflict-shape mismatch, Pitfall 7).
CipherBoxFS sources the api client, owner keypair, and tokio runtime that the RotationDeps adapter needs to close over.
rotate_read_on_scope_exit stub — missing root_node_id and root_read_key inputs that must be threaded through.
fs.rt.block_on async bridge — already correctly implemented for calling into async rotation code from sync FUSE ops.
Poisoned-lock .expect(...) panic on the cache, and second fail-open site for D-15a.
Bin-ref-before-gate ordering bug feeding into D-15d.
Second bin-ref-before-gate site for D-15d fix.
POSIX-after-gate ordering bug plus a dest_ino gap (D-15d).
Existing test harness reused as the cheap two-tier test target for all 4 gate fixes plus the adapter-over-faked-transport test.
Test unlink_shared_scope_exit_fails_closed_until_rotation_wired currently asserts EIO; this is the one existing test that must invert once rotation is wired.

workflow: GSD-style phase research is delegated to a background research subagent that re-verifies every referenced line number against the live tree before reporting HIGH confidence.
Per explicit user instruction, the research file was left modified-but-uncommitted for user verification before the assistant proceeded to a separate verify+commit step.
Non-blocking scope decisions surfaced by research (e.g., desktop grant re-mint defaults) are routed to the planner phase rather than interrupting the user directly.

open_items: Production RotationDeps adapter (crates/fuse/src/write_ops/rotation_deps.rs) still needs to be built — currently only test FakeDeps exists.
409 conflict-shape mismatch: adapter must add a follow-up resolve+fetch to materialize PublishedNode for PublishAttempt::Conflict.

ancestor_ipns_chain and the rotation gate need signature changes (Result/authoritativeness bit) to make fail-closed behavior expressible.

Desktop grant re-mint (query_grants_rooted_at/update_grant/delete_grant) can start as trait no-ops but leaves ROT-04 (no orphaned inner grant) unenforced on desktop — flagged for the planner to make an explicit documented scope decision.

Test delete.rs:644 (unlink_shared_scope_exit_fails_closed_until_rotation_wired) must be inverted from asserting EIO once rotation is wired; two other private-delete tests must switch to authoritative-empty seeding.
